profiles_select.name: profiles_select
profiles_select.using:
auth_role() = 'admin'
        or "profiles"."id" = auth.uid()
        or ("profiles"."org_id" is not null and "profiles"."org_id" = auth_org_id())
        or exists (
          select 1 from partners p
           where p.id = profiles.id and p.status = 'active'
        )

partner_exceptions_select.name: partner_exceptions_select
partner_exceptions_select.using:
auth_role() in ('admin','moderator')
        or "partner_exceptions"."partner_id" = auth.uid()
        or exists (
          select 1 from partners p
           where p.id = partner_exceptions.partner_id and p.status = 'active'
        )

bookings_select_participants.name: bookings_select_participants
bookings_select_participants.using: "bookings"."professional_id" = auth.uid() or "bookings"."partner_id" = auth.uid() or auth_role() in ('admin','moderator')

briefings_select_participants.name: briefings_select_participants
briefings_select_participants.using:
exists (
          select 1 from bookings b
           where b.id = briefings.booking_id
             and (b.professional_id = auth.uid() or b.partner_id = auth.uid())
        )
